WITH venue_games AS (
    SELECT 
        b.BowlerID,
        b.BowlerFirstName,
        b.BowlerLastName,
        bs.MatchID,
        bs.GameNumber,
        bs.HandiCapScore,
        t.TourneyDate,
        t.TourneyLocation
    FROM Bowler_Scores bs
    JOIN Bowlers b ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
    JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE bs.WonGame = 1
      AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190
      AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
),
venue_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        BowlerID,
        BowlerFirstName,
        BowlerLastName,
        COUNT(DISTINCT TourneyLocation) as venue_count
    FROM venue_games
    GROUP BY BowlerID, BowlerFirstName, BowlerLastName
)
SELECT 
    vg.BowlerID,
    vg.BowlerFirstName,
    vg.BowlerLastName,
    vg.MatchID,
    vg.GameNumber,
    vg.HandiCapScore,
    vg.TourneyDate,
    vg.TourneyLocation
FROM venue_games vg
JOIN venue_counts vc ON vg.BowlerID = vc.BowlerID
WHERE vc.venue_count = 3
ORDER BY vg.BowlerID, vg.TourneyLocation, vg.GameNumber;
